fields.disappearance: Pauṣa Kṛṣṇa Trayodaśī (one text: Śukla Trayodaśī)
fields.place: Pālapāḍā near Cākdaha (Nadia), with his samādhi; earlier Saraḍāṅgā, then Maśipura (Yaśipura), then Beleḍāṅgā
fields.notes:
One of the twelve gopālas (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.32), counted also in Mahāprabhu's branch (Ādi 10.11). Younger brother of Jagadīśa Paṇḍita of Yaśaḍā (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura: some say so). Very dear to Nityānanda; at the Pāṇihāṭi festival; met Narottama at Khaḍadaha (Bhakti-ratnākara 8.220). His Deities and samādhi were moved to Pālapāḍā when the Ganges took his villages.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Mahābāhu (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 129).

fields.place: Sukhasāgara (near Cākdaha); his Deities now at Cāndūḍe-grāma near Pālapāḍā; family later at Bodhkhānā (Jessore) and Bhājanghāṭ (Nadia)
fields.notes:
One of the twelve gopālas; son of Sadāśiva Kavirāja (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.38-39; Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 5.741-742). Wife: Jāhnavā, who died at the birth of their son Kānu Ṭhākura (Śiśu Kṛṣṇadāsa), whom Nityānanda took to Khaḍadaha. Disciples Mādhavācārya (husband of Gaṅgā Devī), Yādavācārya and Devakīnandana dāsa. Wrote songs. Bhaktivedānta Svāmī calls him Nāgara Puruṣottama; the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā counts Nāgara Puruṣottama as another gopāla.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Stoka-kṛṣṇa (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 130; Bhaktamāla 3).

fields.name: Puruṣottama Nāgara (son of Īśāna Nāgara)
fields.place: Teotha-Bāṅkpāl (Dhaka district), on the eastern bank of the Padmā
fields.notes:
Eldest son of Īśāna Nāgara (of Advaita Ācārya's branch). A stone thrown into the river to test him floated to him; he worshipped it beside his Deity of Jagannātha; it is still worshipped at Vāmandī (Advaita-prakāśa, introduction; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

Not Nāgara Puruṣottama, Dāma gopāla of Nityānanda's branch (his own record).

One of the twelve gopālas of Śrī Nityānanda according to the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā; some lists put Halāyudha Ṭhākura in his place. «Nāgara» may be a title or his family's country. In prema he drank snake venom unharmed (Bhaktamāla 3; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Dāma gopāla.

Not Puruṣottama Nāgara, son of Īśāna Nāgara (his own record). Bhaktivedānta Svāmī identifies him with Puruṣottama dāsa, son of Sadāśiva Kavirāja.

fields.place: Āṭapura (Taḍā-Āṭapura, formerly Viśākhala), Hooghly, with his samādhi; earlier Ketugrāma or Kāugrāma, then Khaḍadaha
fields.notes:
One of the twelve gopālas (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.29); a brāhmaṇa and song-writer (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; another text: of a family of physicians). Very dear servant of Jāhnavā Mātā: went with her to Kheturī and Vṛndāvana, and by her order installed Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Gopīnātha at Āṭapura (Bhakti-ratnākara 13.244-246). Brought a dead jackal back to life in the kīrtana at Ākanā-Māheśa. Told Narottama the road to Purī (Bhakti-ratnākara 8.219).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Arjuna, Kṛṣṇa's cowherd friend (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 132).

fields.aka: Kāla Kṛṣṇadāsa, Kālā Kṛṣṇadāsa, Kāliyā Kṛṣṇadāsa
fields.disappearance: Agrahāyaṇa Kṛṣṇa Dvādaśī (Gauḍīya calendar; also at Sonātalā); Caitra Kṛṣṇa Dvādaśī at Ākāihāṭ (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna and the texts)
fields.place: Ākāihāṭ near Katwa (Bardhamān), with his samādhi; an āśrama at Sonātalā (Pabna)
fields.notes:
One of the twelve gopālas of Śrī Nityānanda (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.37; Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 5.740). Born at Ākāihāṭ in a kulīna brāhmaṇa family. The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna identifies him with the simple brāhmaṇa Kṛṣṇadāsa who went with Mahāprabhu to South India and was tempted away by the Bhaṭṭathāris (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 7, 9, 10); one of the record's texts says they are not the same. Sonātalā tradition: son of Kālidāsa Ṭhākura; sons Mohana dāsa and Gaurāṅga dāsa; Deity Śrī Kālācāṅd.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Lavaṅga (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 132).

fields.name: Halāyudha Ṭhākura
fields.place: Rāmacandrapura, Navadvīpa (north-west bank of the Ganges)
fields.notes:
Associate of Śrī Nityānanda: one of the twelve gopālas according to the Ananta-saṁhitā (in place of Nāgara Puruṣottama), one of the twelve upagopālas according to the Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: the books differ — the second Subala, or Prabala gopāla; a sakhā of Balarāma (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 134; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

fields.disappearance: Kārtika Pūrṇimā (the Gauḍīya calendar keeps it on the next day, Kṛṣṇa Pratipat)

fields.aka: Uddhāraṇa Datta, Uddhāraṇa Ṭhākura, Datta Ṭhākura
